_about: All values in video pixels (1600x1200 frame, 30 fps). Inset web canvas origin = (80, 88), size 1440x1024, so CSS px inside the canvas = video px - (80, 88) at the reference capture scale 1.0. Fitted easing = cubic-bezier over [start, start+duration]. See references/VIDEO_FORENSICS.md.

scenes.note: static thumbnail state (different card poses/art crop) then hard cut
page zoom-out, card fly-in, copy reveals
page scroll 1024px, dark section rises, tiles scale in, header split-inverts

zoom.property: uniform scale of the whole canvas+page content about frame point (800, 600); header excluded

scroll.property: page translateY (hero up, dark section up); total 1024px

entrance.note: logo first visible f008 at +38px, opacity 0.05; settles f035; no zoom

header.theme_switch: per-pixel split along the rising dark-section edge (two header copies, dark copy clipped)

paragraph.note: [top, bottom, right]; line 3 partly gray, line 4 light gray

deco_text.style: 'Personal' outline stroke, '+ Business' solid, near-white gray; static (follows zoom only)

artwork_anchor.evidence: zero-shift NCC 0.97-0.998 between A and B on text-free patches

state_B_dim.model: artwork layer opacity -> ~0.5 over per-tile backing colour (customers untouched)

entrance_scale.model: scale 0->1 about own centre (credit: bottom-centre, ai: x=+51px from centre) while section scrolls
